description: Partial-word replacement: the LEADING and TRAILING phrases of the REPLACING phrase of COPY (ISO §2023:7.2.3.2) and of the REPLACE statement format 1 (ISO §2023:7.2.4.2) - `LEADING | TRAILING ==partial-word-1== BY ==partial-word-2==`, matched against the leftmost / rightmost characters of ONE text-word (§2023:7.2.3.4 GR9 b, §2023:7.2.4.4 GR8 b). THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (VCR row 7.33; the repo holds no 1985, 2002 or 2014 text, ratified decision #1): Annex E (2014->2023) does not list the phrases, so they predate 2023; ANSI X3.23-1985's COPY REPLACING admits only pseudo-text, identifier, literal and word operands and its REPLACE only pseudo-text, so partial-word replacement is a later edition's; GnuCOBOL 3.2 has no dialect option for it (cobc -std=cobol85 and -std=cobol2002 accept it alike - silence, not evidence). The row takes the provisional 2002 edge, the one that never refuses a legal 2002 program (row 7.31's reasoning; the sibling ALSO / LAST row replace-also-last-2002 shares it). ONE gate, asked by the one parser of both statements' operands (CopyProcessor.ParseReplacingOperands through OperandScreen.PartialWord, once per statement; kb/Work PB1670).
display: the LEADING / TRAILING partial-word phrases of COPY REPLACING and REPLACE
